title: AD oracle verification module
objective: Compare symbolic stress/tangent to autodiff-derived reference over random deformation states.
implementation_steps: Implement AD oracle using torch.autograd (or numpy finite differences)
For each constitutive model: compute stress via AD differentiation of strain energy
For each constitutive model: compute tangent via AD differentiation of stress
Compare symbolic results to AD results over 100 random deformation states
Assert relative error < 1e-10 for all comparisons
acceptance_criteria: SVK stress matches AD oracle to relative error < 1e-10 over 100 random states
SVK tangent matches AD oracle to relative error < 1e-10
J2 return mapping matches AD oracle (for elastic regime)

cases: SVK stress: symbolic vs AD over 100 random F
SVK tangent: symbolic vs AD over 100 random F
J2 elastic branch: symbolic vs AD
Random states have J > 0 (physical deformations only)

risks: torch dependency may not be available in all environments — use verify optional group
AD through return mapping requires careful handling of non-smooth yield surface
